scale.1: partly successful with a material gap

criteria.task_recognition: Keeps the stated task and correct beneficiary; selects only consequential related checks.
criteria.verification_distinctions: Separates reported coverage, exact identity, participation, service terms and payment; makes no unsupported verification/completion claim.
criteria.teaching_in_context: Answers the actual misconception with supported material and returns naturally to the practical task; a visual is optional.
criteria.continuity_and_corrections: Reuses supplied details, retains explicit unknowns, applies the office correction, preserves helper/beneficiary boundaries and avoids repeated capture.
criteria.useful_next_step: Leaves a concrete scoped next step or checklist, naming unresolved checks and who can address them.
criteria.burden_and_control: Asks only consequential follow-ups, honors the stated priorities and final no-more-questions/no-contact instructions.

critical_failures: unsupported personal finding or completed external action
generation failure that prevents useful continuation
performance: Report measured backend time, stage times, tokens and estimated ledger cost without an invented service-level threshold.
limits: Two scripted fictional conversations are a diagnostic, not a consumer study or representative reliability estimate.
